name: Scheduled tasks
description: Persist one-shot and recurring prompts, run them in the original conversation and track execution outcomes.
author: Modera

tools.title: Manage scheduled tasks
tools.description: Create, list, pause, resume, remove or recover a task in this project. at must be ISO 8601 with a timezone. intervalSeconds repeats from the scheduled instant (minimum 60). Uses this conversation's current model. Runs while Modera is open; missed occurrences coalesce into one. Interrupted/uncertain dispatches pause for review. Use recover only after the user has reviewed the previous execution outcome; it acknowledges uncertainty and allows future execution. A busy conversation cannot be recovered.

zh-CN.name: 定时任务
zh-CN.description: 持久化单次和周期任务，在原对话中执行并记录结果。
